    • handleListFn

      private static void handleListFn(Map<String,Set<String>> toExtend)
      ListFn is a special special case. Lists can hold any type and ListFn is a VariableArityPredicate, so we need to provide all permutations of TFF types in a list as signatures.

    • handleVariableArity

      private void handleVariableArity(Map<String,Set<String>> toExtend)
      VariableArityRelations are special cases since the different versions only get expanded when axioms are processed but we need to create the different sorts up front. The current set in SUMO as of 1/2019 are AssignmentFn, GreatestCommonDivisorFn, LatitudeFn, LeastCommonMultipleFn, ListFn, LongitudeFn, contraryAttribute, disjointDecomposition, exhaustiveAttribute, exhaustiveDecomposition, partition and processList. ListFn is a special special case
